title: gate.failed payload v3
description: Tier-1 (or other plan) gate verdict on a PR head; THE gate evidence (D-065), emitted by gate_report. v2 (GS1) adds the cached script tests and the failing tests with their signatures. v3 (KD1) adds the known base defects the verdict excused.

tier.description: Gate tier (1 = per-PR gate-dev); null for other plans.

plan.description: The gate mode that ran (dev, db, noite, ...).

stages.description: Every stage that ran, with its time and class.

missing_stages.description: Stages the plan expected that did not pass.

input_hash.description: sha256 of the judged commit, the plan and its expected stages.

cached_tests.description: Script tests reported as cached PASS: the id, the key that matched and the run that recorded the PASS.

failing_tests.description: The tests that failed in this run, id and normalized signature, so a failure is classified without a session; capped at gate.failing_tests_max.

failing_tests_total.description: How many failing tests the run saw before the cap.

known_defects.description: Failing tests that fail on the integration base with the same signature: base defects, listed and not blocking.

id.description: The script test reported as a cached PASS.

key.description: The input-hash key that matched the recorded PASS.

source.description: The run (commit) that recorded the PASS.

id.description: The failing test: the script test path, the vitest `|project| file > suite > name`, or the browser `project file > title`.

stage.description: The gate stage whose log the test failed in.

signature.description: The first error line, normalized (digits, absolute paths and colour codes removed, capped), so the same failure compares equal across runs and bases.
